VERDICT done_when: the done_when asks that the module, schema slots, audit change and tests be committed, the gate show no added failures, and the negative-control and disposable-Neo4j logs be kept; the manifest records all four and I re-derived the gate from the reviewed run's own logs, gate-base.log EXIT=0 81 passed and gate-head.log EXIT=0 91 passed with zero failures on either arm, and gate-head-graph.log EXIT=0 1 passed against a disposable Neo4j started empty.

VERDICT manifest: read; status complete, the six gate files and the negative-control and disposable-graph logs it cites all exist on disk with the results it states; the tests: line (manifest.md:11) is a comma-separated path list rather than the literal command a shell was handed, so it is not the re-runnable form the contract asks for, though the gate logs' own command: header lines carry the invocation.
